title: Get Office 2024 Pro Plus for the Windows PC next to your Mac for $49.97
content:
Macworld

TL;DR: Get Word, Excel, Access, and more on your Windows PC with a lifetime Microsoft Office 2024 Professional Plus license, now $49.97 (reg. $249.99).

Plenty of Mac owners still keep a Windows PC for work, school, or the family desk, and installing Office through Microsoft 365 Personal costs $99.99 a year. A Microsoft Office 2024 Professional Plus lifetime license sets up that PC for a one-time $49.97 (reg. $249.99).

This license works on Windows 10 and 11 PCs only and isn’t compatible with Mac or macOS devices. Install it on the Windows machine, and keep your Mac for everything else.

Professional Plus includes Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, OneNote, and Access. Access isn’t included in the Home or Home & Business editions, so this is the version to get if you build databases or manage business records.

The license is tied to the PC itself rather than your Microsoft account, which keeps the price low. Once installed, Office remains on that one computer without a subscription. Security updates continue throughout the supported lifecycle, and the feature set remains the same rather than changing with each cloud update. You have to redeem your code within 7 days of purchase.

Pay for Office on your Windows PC once instead of every year.

Through Nov. 1 at 11:59 p.m. PT, you can get Microsoft Office 2024 Professional Plus for Windows for $49.97 (reg. $249.99).
